title: Minimum Garden Perimeter To Collect Enough Apples
description:
Apple trees lie at every integer coordinate `(i, j)`, and each tree has `abs(i) + abs(j)` apples. A square plot centered at the origin includes all grid points inside or on its boundary. Return the smallest perimeter of such a plot containing at least `neededApples` apples.

## Examples

```text
Input: neededApples = 1
Output: 8
```

```text
Input: neededApples = 13
Output: 16
```

```text
Input: neededApples = 1000000000
Output: 5040
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= neededApples <= 10^15`
